brief:
The Democratic Front for the Liberation of Palestine attacked the Peace Council statement on Wednesday, saying it reversed facts and disregarded international law rulings, Shehab Wire reported. The Front contended that achieving just and comprehensive peace in the region requires full Israeli withdrawal from occupied territories.

The Democratic Front's statement reflected broader Palestinian faction disputes over peace negotiations and international accountability. The group's criticism centered on what it described as the Peace Council's failure to uphold international legal standards regarding conflict resolution.

title: Democratic Front accuses Peace Council of distorting facts and absolving war criminals
